item.title: About
item.description:
The idea behind this site is to post the occasional tech “stuff” I encounter while working in Linux and my home lab. Hopefully the items I post will be educational to the occasional reader who may find my post beneficial to their tech life.

I work in the Information Technology field as a Linux Systems Administrator at NASA on the Artemis program. In the past I have worked with IBM and NetApp storage; Dell, HP, IBM, and Lenovo servers; Cisco and Ubiquiti networking; Windows, VMware ESXi, and various Linux operating systems. Because I love my career so much I enjoy technology outside of the work place also. When I’m not exploring new tech gadgets, working on my computers, or tweaking my local home lab, I generally enjoy video games, movies, reading, playing and planning TTRPGs (player and GM) and spending time with my family. On my desktop dual-boot I use Windows 11 for games that don’t run on Linux (Minecraft Bedrock with my daughter) and Fedora KDE Plasma for my day-to-day use. Fedora KDE Plasma is also running on my laptop and my family’s computers.
